Metadata.Description: A local AI subscription quota tracker

Quota.NoMatch: No enabled account matches these filters.
Quota.NoAccounts: No accounts yet. Connect a provider to see its quotas.

ResetCredits.Title: Reset credits
ResetCredits.Description: A reset credit resets every quota window of this account at once.
ResetCredits.ConfirmDescription: Use 1 reset credit for {{account}}. Every quota window resets now. This cannot be undone. Credits left after: {{remaining}}.

Login.Title: Add a {{name}} account
Login.PasteCode: Or paste the code from the page

Hint.claude: Sign in to Claude in the browser. The app receives the result on this Mac.
Hint.codex: Sign in with your ChatGPT account in the browser. The app receives the result on this Mac.
Hint.gemini-cli: Sign in with Google in the browser. The app receives the result on this Mac.
Hint.copilot: Enter this code on the GitHub page in the browser, then approve the request.
Hint.cursor: Confirm the sign-in on the Cursor page in the browser. The app receives the result on this Mac.

Rename.Title: Rename account
Rename.Label: Label
Rename.Description: Leave the field empty to show the account id again.

Alerts.Title: Alerts
Alerts.LowQuotaDescription: Alert me when a quota has 20% left.
Alerts.ResetSoonDescription: Alert me 30 minutes before a quota resets.
Alerts.ResetCompleteDescription: Alert me after a quota resets.
Alerts.PermissionRequired: Allow notifications in macOS Settings to use quota alerts.

AutoPing.Title: Quota Optimizer
AutoPing.SupportedDescription: By default, your reset timer only starts counting down on first use. Enabling this option automatically sends a small request to start the timer immediately after each reset. In practice, this means your next reset will come sooner.
AutoPing.UnsupportedDescription: The Quota Optimizer works with Claude and Codex accounts only.

Settings.LaunchAtLoginDescription: Open the app automatically when you log in to your Mac
Settings.MenuBarItemDescription: Show the quotas in the macOS menu bar
Settings.TelemetryDescription: Send anonymous usage events and crash reports. No account names, tokens, or quota numbers.

Updates.Title: Version

Status.PackagedOnly: Updates work in the packaged app only.

Updates.UpToDateToast: You are on the latest version.
Updates.ChannelDescription: Nightly builds get new features first but can be unstable.

Notifications.TestBody: Devie Quota will notify you here about {{account}}.
